name: Vampire Spawn
summary: An undead servant of a vampire that claws and drains blood.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.text:
The vampire has these weaknesses:

**Forbiddance.** The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

**Running Water.** The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

**Stake to the Heart.** The vampire is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition.

**Sunlight.** The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and uses Bite.

actions.name: Claw
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=13}) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Bite

save.targets: one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition

actions.onFailure: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains {ref:glossary/hit-points} equal to that amount.

bonusActions.name: Deathless Agility
bonusActions.text: The vampire takes the {ref:glossary/dash} or {ref:glossary/disengage} action.
